material_fidelity_failures: _validated_prefix validates every supplied row before strict-prefix slicing. A malformed, duplicate, nonmonotonic, or invalid row at or after the fold end can therefore change an earlier fold, directly violating the frozen strict-prefix contract.
_exact_execution_rows repeats the same all-suffix validation through a datetime.max boundary, so execution mapping is not bound to the fold's strict causal prefix.

RepresentativeAccounting.prior_prices is never used. The reconciler marks and reallocates at current_prices, then values the new units at current_prices again, which makes interval_return identically zero and does not independently reconcile adjacent-fill returns.

FillIdentity canonically retains only base execution prices and row identities. The delayed execution vector is checked and discarded, so the delayed fill cannot be independently reconstructed from the artifact.
The final eligible ordinary base fill is silently omitted, and no production helper predeclares, resolves, hashes, and exposes the exact terminal fill strictly inside a half-open boundary.

Canonical mechanical evidence accepts arbitrary unvalidated record mappings and does not itself establish decision-target-fill-disposition relationships; the parent must bind it to the pure trace reconciler before real-data acceptance.
